node.statement: Exact coordinate factorization and pointwise radius: substituting U=sJ bold-dot(J+A+G(A)), W=sJ bold-dot(J+B+G(B)), and U^dagger=W bold-dot(J+Q) and cancelling the scalar s gives J-A+G(A)=(J+B+G(B)) bold-dot(J+Q). Taking the anti-Hermitian projection yields the exact identity -A=B+P^parallel((B+G(B)) bold-dot Q). Since ||G(B)||<=d||B|| and ||Q||<=K_q*C_grp*epsilon_r, choosing the C_der smallness guard so that (1+epsilon_r)(1+d)||Q||<=1/2 gives ||B||<=r+(1/2)||B||, hence ||B||<=2r.
